title: InstructionLeftOut

layer.description: A layer of a run's standing instructions, in the order the text holds them: user (the orientation block, then owned instructions), team-bank, project, session, persona (a bot's), always-on (always-on skills).

id.description: What the part is, within its layer: orientation for the orientation block, else the id of the thing it renders.

reason.description: Why a composed part is not in the text: channel-none (the account's adapter has no instruction channel, so it is handed no text), or over-cap (the text was over the channel's character cap, and owned instructions are left out last first until it fits).

description: A part the layers gave that the text does not hold, and why.
